e.title: FSCS（英国金融服务补偿计划）：失败机构处理、年度报告与征费信息
e.title_en: FSCS (UK Financial Services Compensation Scheme): handling failed firms, annual reports and levy information
e.title_hk: FSCS（英國金融服務補償計劃）：失敗機構處理、年度報告與徵費資訊
e.summary: 英国法定补偿基金：公司倒闭时对合资格客户（含保险保单持有人）给付补偿，公开「保险机构失败后怎么办」、行业资源与 2025/26 年度报告，并公布征费与追偿信息
e.summary_en: The UK statutory compensation fund: it pays compensation to eligible customers (including insurance policyholders) when a firm fails, publishing a "failed insurance companies — what happens next" guide, industry resources, its 2025/26 annual report, and levy and recovery information
e.summary_hk: 英國法定補償基金：公司倒閉時對合資格客戶（含保險保單持有人）給付補償，公開「保險機構失敗後怎麼辦」、行業資源與 2025/26 年度報告，並公布徵費與追償資訊
e.body:
**FSCS（Financial Services Compensation Scheme，英国金融服务补偿计划）** 是**英国的法定补偿基金**——当受监管金融机构倒闭、无法自行赔付时，对**合资格客户**给付补偿，范围含**保险保单持有人**（与拟保障事项不同，**FSCS 处理的是「公司已经倒了」这一情形**）。本条目与同轮的 **[[fos-uk]]** 构成一对：**FOS 处理「公司还活着但有争议」，FSCS 处理「公司倒了」**——**这是消费者保护事后层的两条不同通道**。实测池内该形态（保险补偿/失败机构处理）**成员为 0**；池内最接近的是 **[[hkmc]]**（按揭保险与公共年金，**性质不同**）与 **[[pbgc]]**（**养老金**给付保证）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页标题实测为 **「Financial Services Compensation Scheme | FSCS」**；⭐ **「Failed insurance companies – what happens next?」页 `/making-a-claim/claims-process/failed-ins-co-next/`，实测 142.4KB，标题与页面名一致**；⭐ **「Industry resources」页 `/industry-resources/`，实测 140.3KB**；⭐ **「FSCS Annual Report 2025/26」页 `/industry-resources/other-publications/annual-report/`，实测 148.3KB**；**「Levy information（征费信息）」页 `/about-us/funding/levy-info/`，实测 143.0KB**；导航实测另含 **`/about-us/funding/`**、**`/about-us/funding/recoveries/`（追偿）**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/eligibility-rules/`（合资格规则）**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/temporary-high-balances/`（临时高额余额）**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/appeal-claim-decision/`（对决定上诉）**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/claim-status/`**、**`/making-a-claim/claims-process/defined-benefit-pension-transfers/`**、**`/making-a-claim/customer-info/financial-protection/`** 与 **`/making-a-claim/customer-info/fscs-fos/`（FSCS 与 FOS 的分工说明页）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「补偿机制」这一形态**——池内此前**有监管、有统计、有消费者申诉，但没有「谁最终掏钱赔」这一层**；**FSCS 是法定、由行业征费出资的补偿基金**，与 [[nolhga]] 的**美国州级保障协会模式**形成**「统一法定基金 vs 分散州级协会」两种制度对照**（**两者都叫保障，组织形态完全不同**）。**② 「征费（levy）与追偿（recoveries）」两栏是理解保障成本如何分摊的关键**——**这类机制的成本不是财政承担，而是行业分摊**，对做**保险市场风险与系统性成本**方向的学生是具体材料（可与 [[insurance-governance]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[run-off-tracker]] 并读）。**③ FSCS 与 FOS 的分工值得单独记住**——站点设有专门的 **`fscs-fos`** 说明页，**这正好印证了本条目与 [[fos-uk]] 的结构区分**；**对做消费者保护体系比较的学生，这是一组现成的「两通道」样本**。**④ 年度报告为 2025/26**，说明其披露是连续且近期的。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量与导航结构**，**但未打开年度报告正文、未打开征费或追偿的具体数字、未打开合资格规则、未查看任何补偿案例**，因此**不能转述保障上限金额、征费规模、已赔付金额或合资格条件**；**② 「保障上限」本次完全未核实**——**这是 FSCS 制度最核心的参数，本词条明确不转述**；**③ `fscs-fos` 页本次仅核实其作为导航链接存在，未打开**，故**本词条不转述该页对两机构分工的具体表述**（**文中对 FSCS 与 FOS 的区分来自两站各自页面的性质判断**）；**④ 保险业务在 FSCS 各业务类别中的占比、以及长尾责任（如雇主责任强制保险）的处理本次未核实**；**⑤** 本词条**不主张** FSCS 提供精算工具或保险定价数据。**核实说明**：首页、`/making-a-claim/claims-process/failed-ins-co-next/`（142.4KB）、`/industry-resources/`（140.3KB）、`/industry-resources/other-publications/annual-report/`（148.3KB，标题含 2025/26）、`/about-us/funding/levy-info/`（143.0KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开年报正文、征费与追偿数字、合资格规则或任何补偿案例**。
e.body_en:
**FSCS (the Financial Services Compensation Scheme)** is **the United Kingdom’s statutory compensation fund**: when a regulated firm fails and cannot pay, it compensates **eligible customers**, including **insurance policyholders** (unlike a prospective guarantee, **FSCS handles the case where the firm has already failed**). This entry pairs with [[fos-uk]] from the same round: **FOS handles "the firm is alive but there is a dispute"; FSCS handles "the firm has failed"** — **two distinct channels of the post-sale consumer-protection layer**. A measured count found **zero members of this form** (insurance compensation and failed-firm handling); the closest items are **[[hkmc]]** (mortgage insurance and public annuities, **a different thing**) and **[[pbgc]]** (**pension** benefit insurance).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage title reads **"Financial Services Compensation Scheme | FSCS"**; ⭐ the **"Failed insurance companies – what happens next?" page `/making-a-claim/claims-process/failed-ins-co-next/` measures 142.4KB with a matching title**; ⭐ the **"Industry resources" page `/industry-resources/` measures 140.3KB**; ⭐ the **"FSCS Annual Report 2025/26" page `/industry-resources/other-publications/annual-report/` measures 148.3KB**; the **"Levy information" page `/about-us/funding/levy-info/` measures 143.0KB**; measured navigation also includes **`/about-us/funding/`**, **`/about-us/funding/recoveries/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/eligibility-rules/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/temporary-high-balances/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/appeal-claim-decision/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/claim-status/`**, **`/making-a-claim/claims-process/defined-benefit-pension-transfers/`**, **`/making-a-claim/customer-info/financial-protection/`** and **`/making-a-claim/customer-info/fscs-fos/` (a page explaining the FSCS-FOS division of labour)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "compensation mechanism" form** — the corpus previously had **supervision, statistics and consumer complaints, but no layer for "who ultimately pays"**; **FSCS is a statutory fund financed by industry levies**, contrasting with **[[nolhga]]**’s **US state-level guaranty association model** — **"a unified statutory fund versus dispersed state associations": both are called guarantees, yet their organisational forms differ completely**. **② The "levy" and "recoveries" sections are key to understanding how the cost is shared** — **this mechanism is not financed by the public purse but by the industry**, concrete material for students working on **insurance market risk and systemic cost** (readable with [[insurance-governance]], [[ggsolvencyii]] and [[run-off-tracker]]). **③ The FSCS-FOS division is worth remembering on its own** — the site keeps a dedicated **`fscs-fos`** page, **which corroborates the structural distinction between this entry and [[fos-uk]]**; **for students comparing consumer-protection systems, this is a ready "two-channel" sample**. **④ The annual report is for 2025/26**, indicating continuous and recent disclosure.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes and navigation structure**, **but opened no annual report body, no levy or recovery figures, no eligibility rules and no compensation case**, so **compensation limits, levy size, amounts paid and eligibility conditions cannot be restated**; **② compensation limits were entirely unverified** — **the single most central parameter of the FSCS regime, explicitly not restated here**; **③ the `fscs-fos` page was verified only as an existing navigation link and not opened**, so **this entry does not restate that page’s own account of the division** (**the distinction drawn here rests on the nature of each body’s pages**); **④ the share of insurance within FSCS business categories, and the treatment of long-tail liabilities such as compulsory employers’ liability, were not verified**; **⑤** this entry **does not claim FSCS provides actuarial tools or insurance pricing data**. **Verification note**: the homepage, `/making-a-claim/claims-process/failed-ins-co-next/` (142.4KB), `/industry-resources/` (140.3KB), `/industry-resources/other-publications/annual-report/` (148.3KB, title containing 2025/26) and `/about-us/funding/levy-info/` (143.0KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no annual report body, levy or recovery figure, eligibility rule or compensation case was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**FSCS（Financial Services Compensation Scheme，英國金融服務補償計劃）** 是**英國的法定補償基金**——當受監管機構倒閉且無法自行賠付時，對**合資格客戶**給付補償，範圍含**保險保單持有人**。本條目與同輪的 **[[fos-uk]]** 構成一對：**FOS 處理「公司還活著但有爭議」，FSCS 處理「公司倒了」**——**這是消費者保護事後層的兩條不同通道**。實測池內該形態**成員為 0**；最接近的是 **[[hkmc]]**（按揭保險與公共年金，**性質不同**）與 **[[pbgc]]**（**養老金**給付保證）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「Financial Services Compensation Scheme | FSCS」**；⭐ **「Failed insurance companies – what happens next?」頁實測 142.4KB**；⭐ **「Industry resources」頁實測 140.3KB**；⭐ **「FSCS Annual Report 2025/26」頁實測 148.3KB**；**「Levy information」頁實測 143.0KB**；導航另含 **funding**、**funding/recoveries（追償）**、**eligibility-rules（合資格規則）**、**temporary-high-balances**、**appeal-claim-decision**、**claim-status**、**defined-benefit-pension-transfers**、**financial-protection** 與 **`fscs-fos`（FSCS 與 FOS 的分工說明頁）**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「補償機制」這一形態**——池內此前**有監管、有統計、有申訴，但沒有「誰最終掏錢賠」這一層**；**FSCS 是法定、由行業徵費出資的補償基金**，與 [[nolhga]] 的**美國州級保障協會模式**形成**「統一法定基金 vs 分散州級協會」兩種制度對照**。**② 「徵費與追償」是理解保障成本如何分攤的關鍵**——**成本不是財政承擔，而是行業分攤**（可與 [[insurance-governance]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[run-off-tracker]] 並讀）。**③ FSCS 與 FOS 的分工值得單獨記住**——站點設有專門的 **`fscs-fos`** 說明頁，**正好印證本條目與 [[fos-uk]] 的結構區分**。**④ 年度報告為 2025/26**，披露連續且近期。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量與導航結構**，**但未打開年度報告正文、未打開徵費或追償數字、未打開合資格規則、未查看任何補償案例**，故**不能轉述保障上限金額、徵費規模、已賠付金額或合資格條件**；**② 「保障上限」本次完全未核實**——**本詞條明確不轉述**；**③ `fscs-fos` 頁本次僅核實其作為導航連結存在、未打開**，故**不轉述該頁對兩機構分工的具體表述**；**④ 保險業務在 FSCS 各類別中的佔比、以及長尾責任（如僱主責任強制保險）的處理未核實**；**⑤** 本詞條**不主張** FSCS 提供精算工具或保險定價數據**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並讀取標題與導航；**未打開年報正文、徵費與追償數字、合資格規則或任何補償案例**。
